page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Right margin carries small "«" line-end marks, which are printer's ornaments, not text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: est. Depulsio est: Imò mea, qui
tris sum factus. Quæstio est, u-
trorum sit? Ratio est: Pater e-
to patris mea fiat necesse est.
quam quòd ipsius fuit in te-
ne quisquam de filij pupilli re

page.notes: Printed "«" marks at each line end in the right margin are ornaments, not transcribed. The printed "|" in "Depulsio|est" is a stray mark, so it was read as "Depulsio est". The "qu̧" before "filij" is a doubtful form (read as quę [?]). The catchword "quo-" is a hyphenated word at the foot right. The signature "k 5" is at the foot left-centre.
